en.title: Fry Docs first version
items: A document editor you write in right on an A4 page
Headings 1·2·3, quotes, bulleted and numbered lists, bold · italic · underline · strikethrough · text color, alignment, sans-serif and serif fonts
Tables with rows and columns to add and remove, pictures in a chosen size, dividers
Export as a Word file (docx), PDF, web page or text file
Open Word documents, web pages and text files (pictures inside Word documents are left out)
Document list, autosave, version history, bring back a deleted document
AI helper (beta): fix spelling, simpler, summary, keep writing
